title: Data Router
statement: Implement a 4-way data router that selects one of four 8-bit inputs based on a 2-bit select signal. The selected input should appear on the output without any registered delay. This module is a basic datapath element for multiplexed data paths.
module_signature: module data_router(input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, input [7:0] c, input [7:0] d, input [1:0] sel, output [7:0] y);
behavior: y equals the selected input based on sel.
No state or clocking is allowed.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
hint: Use a single multiway select structure.
